# 📡 Webhook Schema & Handling

This document defines the schema and expected structure for **Shopify webhooks** handled by the `webhook-gateway` system.

It supports downstream processing for:
- `Preorder Service`
- `Backorder Service`
- `NYT Weekly Reporting Tool` (via integration with Preorder Service)
- Future third-party forwarding

---

## ✅ Webhook Envelope Structure

All incoming Shopify webhooks are validated via HMAC and logged to Supabase with the following structure in `public.webhook_logs`:

```json
{
  "id": "uuid", // webhook_logs.id (UUID, autogenerated)
  "topic": "products/update", // Shopify topic
  "shop_domain": "example.myshopify.com", // Source domain
  "source": "shopify", // e.g. "shopify" or other system origin
  "received_at": "2025-11-08T14:52:00.000Z", // Original webhook timestamp
  "created_at": "2025-11-08T14:52:01.000Z", // DB insert timestamp
  "replayed": false,
  "replay_notes": null,
  "replay_timestamp": null,
  "payload": { ... }  // Raw Shopify webhook payload (JSONB)
}
```

This structure supports observability, replay, and eventual retry workflows.

## 🔁 Replay & Forwarding

Webhook Gateway supports:
- Replay: `GET /replay/:id`
- Replay metadata: `replayed`, `replay_notes`, `replay_timestamp`

Inbound payloads are stored in:
- `public.webhook_logs` (primary insert log)
- `public.external_deliveries` (future: delivery tracking to downstream services)

---

## 📦 Supabase Schema: `public.webhook_logs`

| Column           | Type       | Description                              |
|------------------|------------|------------------------------------------|
| `id`             | UUID       | Primary key, auto-generated              |
| `source`         | Text       | Source of the webhook (e.g. 'shopify')   |
| `payload`        | JSONB      | Full raw webhook payload                 |
| `topic`          | Text       | Shopify topic (e.g. `products/update`)   |
| `shop_domain`    | Text       | Shopify store domain                     |
| `received_at`    | Timestamp  | When the webhook was originally received |
| `created_at`     | Timestamp  | When inserted into Supabase              |
| `replayed`       | Boolean    | Whether the event was replayed           |
| `replay_notes`   | Text       | Developer notes on replay                |
| `replay_timestamp` | Timestamp | When replay was triggered               |

---

## 📤 Gateway Forwarding Schema

### Outbound Delivery Headers (External Services)

For all forwarded requests, the following headers are included:

| Header Name               | Purpose                                        |
|---------------------------|------------------------------------------------|
| `X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256`   | Original Shopify signature (pass-through)     |
| `X-Shopify-Topic`         | Shopify topic (e.g. `products/update`)        |
| `X-Shopify-Shop-Domain`   | Original store domain                         |
| `X-Gateway-Event-ID`      | UUID from `webhook_logs.id`                   |
| `X-Gateway-Timestamp`     | ISO timestamp of delivery                     |
| `X-Gateway-Signature`     | HMAC over raw body (using `EXTERNAL_HMAC_SECRET`) |
| `X-Forwarded-By`          | Constant: `webhook-gateway`                   |
| `Content-Type`            | `application/json`                            |

Forwarded requests include the **original raw body** (unmodified) to preserve Shopify signature verification compatibility.

Downstream services can validate:
1. `X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256` using `SHOPIFY_API_SECRET`  
2. Optionally fall back to `X-Gateway-Signature` using `GATEWAY_HMAC_SECRET`

---

## 🧱 Service-Level Schemas

Downstream services (e.g. `damaged-books-service`, `preorder-service`) may log derived or enriched data into dedicated Supabase schemas such as:

- `damaged.*`
- `preorder.*`
- `backorder.*`

These service-owned schemas remain logically independent from the gateway but may include foreign keys referencing `webhook_logs.id`.
